title: A rate limit meets one criterion, and the PR names the follow-up ticket

pr.title: Limit the requests of each API key
pr.description: Adds the limit of 100 requests per minute for each API key. A request over the limit gets status 429. The Retry-After header comes in SHOP-42.

task:
Add a rate limit to the public API.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Each API key gets at most 100 requests per minute. A request over the limit gets status 429.
2. The 429 reply has a Retry-After header with the seconds until the current window ends.

traps.why: The PR text says that the Retry-After header of criterion 2 comes in SHOP-42, so the rest of the criterion is deferred to a named ticket. A finding of an unmet criterion is wrong.
